description: Contemplative cinematic narrator for the RSIFF 2026 'Cinema Lives Here' manifesto. Slow, deliberate, warm, authoritative. Roughly the register of a Morgan Freeman / Ben Kingsley documentary read — grounded, unhurried, weight on every line.

pacing.note: Manifesto rhythm — slow, reflective, with full beats between short lines. Do NOT compress pauses. Add explicit <break> markers in SSML where the script has paragraph breaks.

qwen3Fallback.speaker: Ryan
qwen3Fallback.note: If using Qwen3-TTS instead of ElevenLabs. Temperature kept moderate to avoid over-expressive delivery on a solemn script.

notes: English-language narration only for this manifesto. Arabic titles appear on-screen alongside the English title lockups but are not spoken in the default cut.
